competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.subtitle: Sync coverage (what the system keeps fresh) and Match Bar flags (what visitors see) — fully independent.

empty.title: No competitions yet
empty.description: Add a competition using its provider ID to get started.

form.providerIdHint: The competition's numeric ID at the provider (e.g. 365Scores).
form.name: Name

confirm.deleteText: This will delete “{{name}}” and its synced fixtures. This cannot be undone.

competitions.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage competitions.

matchBarSettings.title: Match Bar
matchBarSettings.desc: A single, exclusive mode controls what the homepage Match Bar shows. Switching modes replaces the previous one immediately — no merge state.

source.featured_competitions_desc: Show fixtures only from competitions flagged “Featured” (e.g. Club World Cup today, a different tournament later).
source.regular_leagues_desc: Show fixtures only from competitions flagged “Show in Match Bar”.

matchBarSettings.emptyWarning: Heads up: this mode is enabled but no competitions currently qualify for it — the bar won't appear to visitors until at least one competition is flagged accordingly on the Competitions page.
matchBarSettings.noPermission: You don't have permission to edit settings.
